trello.name: Send final DataBridge renewal terms request
trello.desc: Owner: Sofia. Send one final email today to DataBridge account manager in plain language requesting revised renewal terms by Thursday close of business. Email should reference previous two emails (last sent Monday) and note contract lapses August 29th. Acceptance criteria: email sent today, clearly states deadline Thursday COB for revised terms, and is documented for follow-up.

trello.name: Escalate DataBridge non-response to legal
trello.desc: Owner: Sofia. If DataBridge has not replied by Thursday close of business, escalate to legal on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options. Do not wait for further approval; the no-reply-by-Thursday-COB condition is the trigger. Acceptance criteria: escalation email/meeting request sent to legal Friday morning only if no response received by Thursday COB, with summary of prior outreach and contract lapse date.

trello.name: Request cryptography review of security audit from Dana
trello.desc: Owner: Sofia. Message Dana on platform team today, framed as a request from Ravi, asking her to review sections 4 and 6 of the external security audit report covering cryptography and key management findings. Request her assessment be sent to this group before the next sync in two weeks. If Dana does not have bandwidth, note to escalate to her manager, but ask nicely first. Acceptance criteria: request sent today with report attached/linked, sections 4 and 6 specified, two-week deadline communicated, and confirmation of receipt.

trello.name: Update rebrand FAQ with logo decision
trello.desc: Owner: Tomas. Add a line to the rebrand FAQ stating the logo stays as is and only the color palette changes, with a link to the March meeting notes where the decision was made. This addresses recurring questions. Complete this week. Acceptance criteria: FAQ updated with explicit logo decision statement and working link to March meeting notes, and change is visible to Marketing/stakeholders.
